feature.label: ABAP Guardian
feature.description: AI-assisted static analysis and code review for SAP ABAP. Deterministic performance, security and privacy rules with optional hosted AI enhancement, docked Copilot chat, live findings, editor markers and preview-only corrections. The Eclipse user installs only this plug-in; analysis is provided by the configured HTTPS service.
